description: Search Quora public questions, answers, posts, profiles, topics, or Spaces while preserving native GraphQL fields and using a visible DOM fallback when page data drifts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results, strict positive integer from 1 to 100

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Search result type: all, question, answer, post, profile, topic, or tribe (Spaces)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Standard sort: default or latest; popular is accepted and reported as ignored because Quora exposes relevance/recent only

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Standard time range: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Maps to Quora's search page "By time" filter (Past hour / Past day / Past week / Past month / Past year).
